app_info.subtitle: Rig, animate and render 2D
app_info.description: Armature 2D helps you create and edit skeletal rigs through ChatGPT. Build bones, slots and attachments; author animation keyframes and constraints; inspect solved poses and meshes; render PNG previews; and validate, save and reopen skeleton JSON in your private project workspace. Editing tools use the application command system with undo and redo. Additional tools author effects and slot scenes in independent headless sessions. The app does not control a running desktop editor, and skeleton save and export do not persist a complete effects or slot editor project. Imported Spine projects may require conversion and include an import loss report. Rendering without usable textures can return a placeholder preview.

test_cases.description: Create and validate a minimal bone hierarchy.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a new Armature skeleton with a root bone and one child, then list the bones and validate it.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns document and bone identifiers, shows the child parent relationship, and reports validation results.

test_cases.description: Verify reversible edits on a newly created skeleton.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a new Armature skeleton with one root bone, move the root 20 units to the right, undo that move, then redo it and inspect the root after each step.
test_cases.tools_triggered: document.new, bone.create, bone.move, bone.get, history.undo, history.redo
test_cases.expected_output: The inspected root position returns to its initial value after undo and to the edited value after redo.

test_cases.description: Author and inspect an animated pose.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a new Armature skeleton with a root bone and a one-second animation that rotates the root from zero to 90 degrees, then sample its world transform halfway through.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates rotation keyframes and returns the solved transform at the requested animation time without changing the setup pose.

test_cases.description: Render a rig without texture assets and explain the preview limitation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a new Armature skeleton with a root, a slot and a rectangular region attachment, then render a PNG preview without adding a texture atlas. Tell me whether placeholders were used.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a PNG preview and reports placeholder use instead of claiming the attachment is textured.

test_cases.description: Save and reopen a skeleton in the private project workspace.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a new Armature skeleton with a root and child bone, save it in my project, reopen the saved skeleton, and compare its exported hierarchy with the original.
test_cases.expected_output: Saves and reopens valid skeleton JSON within the private workspace and preserves the bone hierarchy; does not claim to save a complete effects or slot scene project.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke tools for desktop window control.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Click the animation timeline in my running desktop editor and drag its window to my other monitor.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explains that Armature tools operate in headless sessions and cannot control desktop windows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke tools for unrelated public publishing.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Publish a marketing announcement to my social media accounts.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Armature because the app has no social publishing tools.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke project tools to modify billing.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Change my Armature subscription and charge a different credit card.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Armature project tools because subscription and payment management are outside their capabilities.
